features: 4.59 cm (1.81 inch) TFT Display: The smartwatch is equipped with a 4.59 cm (1.81 inch) TFT display, providing a clear and responsive screen for smooth interaction with apps and notifications.
Bluetooth Calling: The smartwatch supports Bluetooth calling, allowing you to make and receive calls directly from your wrist, ensuring a convenient and hands-free communication experience.
100+ Cloud-Based Watch Faces: Customize your smartwatch with over 100 cloud-based watch faces, offering a wide variety of designs to match your personal style.

IP67 Water Resistance: Built with IP67 water resistance, the smartwatch is protected against dust and can withstand immersion in water, making it durable for everyday wear and various water-related activities.
Up to 7 Days Battery Life: The smartwatch features a long-lasting battery that can operate for up to 7 days on a single charge, reducing the need for frequent recharging.
550 Nits Brightness: With 550 nits brightness, the display remains easily readable even in bright outdoor conditions, allowing you to view the screen clearly at all times.
description: Display 1.81 inches(4.59cms) TFT display, 240*280px Resolution, 550 nits brightness. Enjoy clear and vibrant visuals on its big and bright TFT display. Up to 7-day battery life Get up to 7 days of battery life & up to 2 days of power with calling activated. (Battery life can vary due to multiple factors such as turning on continuous HR tracking or turning up the brightness) Charging The smartwatch features a 260 mAh battery that takes approx. 2.5 hours to fully charge. It is recommended that you use a 5W power adapter. Please avoid using a fast-charging adapter to prevent future watch damage. Music playback The smartwatch features a remote music control feature that lets you control music played on your phone as long as your smartphone and smartwatch are in Bluetooth range. However, it cannot be used to store music. Volume control You can control the volume both during music playback and while attending calls. The watch can also play music out loud due to the presence of an in-built mic and speaker.
